scope_of_calculation: 54 historical fixed original targets only; actual five reader controls, manifest, terminal, timestamp prefix and runner-added log text are excluded. Values are length arithmetic on frozen pins, not recovered source/log bytes.
static_observations: The owned reader returned success after five seconds. The separate finalizer has a four-minute workflow step timeout and is outside the 900-second process guardian.
output_frames emits each original chunk using synchronous sys.stdout.buffer.write then flush. Byte offset, frame count and raw count increase each iteration; files are bounded and EOF ends each loop.

The exact known original frame lines fit the twelve-MiB raw framing stdout limit before adding the five actual control files and manifest. Without actual report or log, their total and runtime are not proven.
The 389-second observed finalizer duration is compatible with, but does not prove, timeout followed by cancellation/cleanup delay. No timeout conclusion or source-byte acceptance is inferred.
